steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Gitea with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password text exactly as {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}). Then verify you are signed in as admin and report the username shown in the top-right corner.

02-open: Navigate to the repository bench/bench-repo and open its Issues list. Filter to show only OPEN issues. Report the exact titles of all open issues whose title starts with 'Seed:' — copy the titles exactly as displayed, character for character. Also report whether any issue titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue' already exists in the list.

03-create: In the repository bench/bench-repo, create a new issue with the exact title '{{runid}} Bench Issue' and a description (markdown text area) that includes the text '{{runid}}' (for example: 'Bench issue created for run {{runid}}.'). Submit the issue. Then report the issue's title, its number as displayed (Gitea shows it as #<number>), and confirm the description text shown on the issue page includes {{runid}}. Do not set labels, assignee or milestone yet.

04-set: On the issue page for issue {{03-create.issue_number}} in bench/bench-repo (titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue', at /bench/bench-repo/issues/{{03-create.url.p3}}), use the sidebar pickers to set: (1) exactly the two labels 'bug' and 'priority-high' ({{02-open.Bench Issue exists}} other labels), (2) the assignee user 'bench-assignee', and (3) the milestone 'Bench Milestone'. For each picker, open it, select the item, and wait until the app has applied it and shows it on the issue page (e.g. the label chips, assignee name, and milestone name visible in the sidebar) — not merely a tick in the open menu. Then report exactly which labels are shown on the issue, the assignee shown, and the milestone shown.

05-add: On the issue page for issue {{03-create.issue_number}} in bench/bench-repo (titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue', at /bench/bench-repo/issues/{{03-create.url.p3}}), add a comment using the markdown comment text area at the bottom of the page. The comment text must include '{{runid}}' (for example: 'Comment for run {{runid}}.'). Submit the comment and wait until it appears on the page. Then report the exact comment text as displayed and confirm it includes {{runid}}.

06-open: Open the issue page at {{03-create.url}} and verify all of the following, reporting the exact values shown on the page: (1) the issue title and its number as displayed (Gitea shows it as #<number>), (2) the exact list of labels shown on the issue (report every label chip, and state whether it is exactly 'bug' and 'priority-high' and nothing else), (3) the assignee shown, (4) the milestone shown, (5) the description text and whether it includes '{{runid}}', (6) whether there is a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' and what that comment text is. Also confirm the issue is open (not closed).

07-report: Reload the issue page at {{03-create.url}} and report: the issue state badge (Open or Closed), the title, the number as displayed, the labels shown, the assignee shown, the milestone shown, and confirm the description and at least one comment still include the text '{{runid}}'.
